verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਤ ਰਾਖਤ ਜਨਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਗੁਨ ਮਾਤਾ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਨ ਚੇਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan praan sut raakhat jananee prat avagun gun maataa chit mai na chet hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a son leaves his understanding, perception and protection of his life in the care of his mother, and she too does not think of her son's merits and demerits.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਭਰਤਾਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਉਰ ਹਾਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਲਾਲੁ ਲਲਨਾ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਲੇਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bharataar bhaar naar ur haar maanai taa(n) te laal lalanaa ko maan man let hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a wife filled with love of her husband, bears all the load of her husband on her mind, the husband too makes loving and respectful room for her in his heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਚਟੀਆ ਸਭੀਤਿ ਸਕੁਚਤ ਪਾਂਧਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਚੂਕਿ ਪਾਂਧਾ ਛਾਡਤ ਨ ਹੇਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise chaTeeaa sabheet sakuchat paa(n)dhaa pekh taa(n) te bhool chook paa(n)dhaa chhaaddat na het hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a student feels petrified at the sight of the teacher and as a reaction, the teacher too ignores his mistakes under the influence of this reverential fear and does not give up loving him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਿਖ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਮ ਦੂਤਹਿ ਨ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੫੮॥
verses.translit_en: man bach kram gur charan saran sikh taa te satigur jam dhooteh na dhet hai ||358||

en.bdb: Similarly, a Sikh of the Guru who takes the refuge of the True Guru with devotion and love in his heart, the True Guru does not let him fall in the hands of angels of death when he is about to leave for the world beyond. The True Guru provides him a place in the holy feet of the Lord. (358)
